phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 12 Gauge (70mm Black-Powder / Smokeless) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 65 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 65 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 762 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Lever Throw Cycle & Operating Impulse

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 5-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Win M1887 staged for its 35 RPM (lever cycle) cadence.

zh.headline: 温彻斯特 M1887 杠杆式连珠霰弹枪：1887 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 温彻斯特 M1887 是人类历史上第一款真正取得商业成功的连珠霰弹枪：天才枪械师约翰·勃朗宁在温彻斯特坚持“杠杆血统”的要求下，以精巧的下摆滚轮式闭锁块配合顶部开启式装填口，让粗短 12 号霰弹实现流畅杠杆连射。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Win M1887 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1887 年问世的 温彻斯特 M1887 杠杆式连珠霰弹枪 由美国温彻斯特连发武器公司（Winchester Repeating Arms）主导研制，定位为经典的滚轮块杠杆式连珠霰弹枪。勃朗宁本人最初曾建议温彻斯特采用泵动结构，但公司坚持品牌杠杆形象；后来随着无烟火药兴起，勃朗宁的泵动方案最终化身为经典的 M1897 战壕枪。
温彻斯特 M1887 是人类历史上第一款真正取得商业成功的连珠霰弹枪：天才枪械师约翰·勃朗宁在温彻斯特坚持“杠杆血统”的要求下，以精巧的下摆滚轮式闭锁块配合顶部开启式装填口，让粗短 12 号霰弹实现流畅杠杆连射。 整件装备总长 1,187 mm（46.75 in）、空重 3.63 kg，成为同期霰弹枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1887 年，美国温彻斯特连发武器公司（Winchester Repeating Arms）推出了划时代的温彻斯特 M1887 杠杆式连珠霰弹枪。勃朗宁本人最初曾建议温彻斯特采用泵动结构，但公司坚持品牌杠杆形象；后来随着无烟火药兴起，勃朗宁的泵动方案最终化身为经典的 M1897 战壕枪。 它的核心设计聚焦于世界首款成功量产的连珠霰弹枪，由约翰·勃朗宁亲自操刀设计，奠定了其在霰弹枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 温彻斯特 M1887 杠杆式连珠霰弹枪 的机械灵魂在于其「约翰·勃朗宁下摆滚动闭锁块杠杆机构 · 顶抛式管状弹仓」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，扳机护圈杠杆下摆驱动闭锁块解锁并牵引载弹托板将新弹升至弹膛轴线，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托精加工而成。紧凑型滚轮式下摆闭锁块与护圈杠杆联动，打开机匣顶部即可装弹，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。温彻斯特 M1887 杠杆式连珠霰弹枪 采用约翰·勃朗宁下摆滚动闭锁块杠杆机构 · 顶抛式管状弹仓。在每个击发周期中，扳机护圈杠杆下摆驱动闭锁块解锁并牵引载弹托板将新弹升至弹膛轴线。借助发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托工艺与高强度配合，实现了紧凑型滚轮式下摆闭锁块与护圈杠杆联动，打开机匣顶部即可装弹。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 12 Gauge (70mm Black-Powder / Smokeless) 弹药规格与 762 mm（30 in 烤蓝大马士革/流体钢滑膛枪管），最高工作膛压约 65 MPa，可赋予弹头 365 m/s 的出膛初速与 2,620 J 动能，有效作用距离达 40 米。
内膛技术特点方面，18.5 mm 经典全喉缩滑膛钢枪管，专为 19 世纪末黑火药纸壳 12 号弹设计。同时，管状弹仓可装 5 发 + 托弹板与弹膛各 1 发，形成 7 发强悍续航，令其在 35 发/分（杠杆回转连射） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 762 毫米身管与 12 Gauge (70mm Black-Powder / Smokeless) 口径，温彻斯特 M1887 杠杆式连珠霰弹枪 实现了每秒 365 米的初速与 40 米有效射程。18.5 mm 经典全喉缩滑膛钢枪管，专为 19 世纪末黑火药纸壳 12 号弹设计，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 5 发容量的枪管下方管状内置弹仓与 34 mm 膛轴设计，温彻斯特 M1887 杠杆式连珠霰弹枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 20.4 N·s 水平。烤蓝机匣搭配美洲黑胡桃直握把托，兼具机械巧思与西部时代美学。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-79）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 5 发容量的枪管下方管状内置弹仓与出色的整体工效，烤蓝机匣搭配美洲黑胡桃直握把托，兼具机械巧思与西部时代美学。欢迎在 BAY-79 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 温彻斯特 M1887 杠杆式连珠霰弹枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Win M1887
paragraphs: Introduced in 1887 by Winchester Repeating Arms in United States, the Winchester Model 1887 Lever-Action Shotgun emerged as a defining Rolling-Block Lever-Action Shotgun. Browning originally advocated a pump action, yet honored Winchester’s lever-action heritage for the 1887 before later creating the smokeless-powder Model 1897 pump.

The world’s first commercially successful repeating shotgun, the Winchester Model 1887 saw John Moses Browning invent a compact rolling-block lever mechanism at Winchester’s insistence—pivoting the breech downward to load and eject stubby 12-gauge shells through the top. Measuring 1,187 mm (46.75 in) at an unloaded weight of 3.63 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Combat Shotgun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1887, Winchester Repeating Arms of United States introduced the Winchester Model 1887 Lever-Action Shotgun. Browning originally advocated a pump action, yet honored Winchester’s lever-action heritage for the 1887 before later creating the smokeless-powder Model 1897 pump. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — World’s first commercially successful repeating shotgun, engineered by John M. Browning — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Winchester Model 1887 Lever-Action Shotgun sits its John M. Browning Rolling-Block Lever Action · Top-Ejecting Tubular Magazine. Throughout every firing cycle, pivoting finger lever unlocks the breechblock and elevates the next round smoothly onto the bore axis, containing 65 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Pivoting rolling-block breech drops downward on the lever stroke for top loading, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Winchester Model 1887 Lever-Action Shotgun relies on John M. Browning Rolling-Block Lever Action · Top-Ejecting Tubular Magazine. During each cycle, pivoting finger lever unlocks the breechblock and elevates the next round smoothly onto the bore axis. Machined from blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Pivoting rolling-block breech drops downward on the lever stroke for top loading.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 12 Gauge (70mm Black-Powder / Smokeless) with 762 mm (30 in Blued Fluid-Steel Smoothbore), the Winchester Model 1887 Lever-Action Shotgun develops 365 m/s muzzle velocity and 2,620 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 40 meters.

Internally, 18.5 mm full-choke blued smoothbore engineered for late-19th-century 12-gauge shells. Combined with its 35 RPM (lever cycle) tempo, Five-round under-barrel tube plus carrier and chamber hold up to seven shells, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 12 Gauge (70mm Black-Powder / Smokeless) through its 762 millimeter bore, the Winchester Model 1887 Lever-Action Shotgun achieves 365 meters per second and 40 meters of effective reach. 18.5 mm full-choke blued smoothbore engineered for late-19th-century 12-gauge shells.
